A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' was posted at [[Darth Nyriss]]'s [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] in [[3950 BBY]]. He and his dark-skinned [[Unidentified Human guard (dark skin)|companion]] were sent by Nyriss to kill her prisoner&mdash;[[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;when her stronghold was [[Purge of the Dark Council|attacked]] by the [[Imperial Guard]]. Revan convinced them not to kill him, by pointing out that his friends who were on the way would probably kill them if they found him dead, and promised to protect them. When [[Meetra Surik]], [[T3-M4]], and [[Scourge (Sith)|Lord Scourge]] arrived, Revan stopped Scourge from killing the two guards. However, Nyriss arrived intent on stopping Revan, Surik, and Scourge from escaping. She killed both guards with her [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]], turning their bodies to charred husks.<ref name="Revan" />
